# Certificate

The certificate authorities that the host trusts.
`osapi behavior get --name certificate` and `osapi behavior method get` show the
same. [Its chain](../../../chains/security/certificate.md) shows each call that
its examples make.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Description | List the certificate authorities that the host trusts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Detail      | Lists each CA of the trust store through gohai: the distribution's and the local ones on Linux, from the family's directories, and the system keychains on macOS, each with its subject, fingerprint and expiry. A CA that osapi deployed reads by the name that it was deployed with, not its file's osapi- name, and is managed. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/certificate                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Permission  | certificate:read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Command     | [osapi client node certificate list](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/certificate/list.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Output type | \[]Entry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (9)

| FIELD       | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                                                              |
| ----------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name        | string  | The CA: the name it was deployed with for a CA that osapi deployed, else its file's name |
| path        | string  | The file, or on macOS the keychain, that has it                                          |
| source      | string  | system for a CA of the distribution, local for one an administrator added                |
| enabled     | boolean | Whether the host trusts it: false for a system CA that the trust store turns off         |
| subject     | string  | Its subject, such as CN=ISRG Root X1,O=Internet Security Research Group,C=US             |
| fingerprint | string  | The SHA-256 of the certificate, in hex                                                   |
| not_after   | string  | When it expires                                                                          |
| managed     | boolean | Whether osapi deployed it, and its writes change it                                      |
| object      | string  | The object that osapi deployed it from                                                   |

| ----- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name  | string | yes      | pattern ^\[^/%\x00-\x1f\x7f]+$, max length 255 | The CA, as list names it, such as internal-ca, or ISRG Root X1 on macOS; a name with a slash, such as mozilla/ISRG_Root_X1, is in list only, because a path segment cannot have one |

| fingerprint | string  | The SHA-256 of the certificate, in hex                                                   |
| not_after   | string  | When it expires                                                                          |
| managed     | boolean | Whether osapi deployed it, and its writes change it                                      |
| object      | string  | The object that osapi deployed it from                                                   |

## Method create

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | create                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | Add a certificate authority to the trust store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Detail      | Writes the PEM of the object as a file with the osapi- prefix, such as osapi-internal-ca.crt for internal-ca, in the family's local directory: /usr/local/share/ca-certificates on the Debian family, /etc/pki/trust/anchors on SUSE, /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors on RHEL and Fedora. Then it rebuilds the trust store: with update-ca-certificates on the Debian family and SUSE, and with update-ca-trust on the others. Alpine reports skipped. A CA that osapi deployed already with the same content does not change and reports changed: false. A file of that name that osapi did not write is refused. macOS reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/certificate                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Permission  | certificate:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Command     | [osapi client node certificate create](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/certificate/create.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Input type  | CreateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### Input (2)

| FIELD  | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS               | DESCRIPTION                                                                                      |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| name   | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ | The name of the CA, such as internal-ca, which osapi writes as osapi-internal-ca.crt             |
| object | string | yes      | min length 1              | The object of the Object Store that has the PEM of the CA, as osapi client file upload stored it |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The CA                   |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (4)

| EXAMPLE                                        | INPUT                                    | OUTPUT                          |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| Add a CA                                       | name=internal-ca, object=internal-ca.pem | name=internal-ca, changed=true  |
| Add a CA on the RHEL family                    | name=internal-ca, object=internal-ca.pem | name=internal-ca, changed=true  |
| Add a CA on SUSE                               | name=internal-ca, object=internal-ca.pem | name=internal-ca, changed=true  |
| A CA that osapi deployed with the same content | name=internal-ca, object=internal-ca.pem | name=internal-ca, changed=false |

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | Write a certificate authority that osapi deployed again                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Detail      | Writes the CA from the object, or from the one that it was deployed from when the object is empty, and rebuilds the trust store when the file changed. A CA that osapi did not deploy is not found. macOS reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | PUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/certificate/&#123;name&#125;                                                                                                                                                                |
| Permission  | certificate:write                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Command     | [osapi client node certificate update](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/certificate/update.md)                                                                                                                            |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### Input (2)

| FIELD  | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS               | DESCRIPTION                                                          |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name   | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ | The CA that osapi deployed, such as internal-ca                      |
| object | string | no       | min length 1              | The object that has the PEM; the one it was deployed from when empty |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The CA                   |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (4)

| Write a CA from a new object                    | name=internal-ca, object=internal-ca-2.pem | name=internal-ca, changed=true  |
| Write a CA from a new object on the RHEL family | name=internal-ca, object=internal-ca-2.pem | name=internal-ca, changed=true  |
| Write a CA from a new object on SUSE            | name=internal-ca, object=internal-ca-2.pem | name=internal-ca, changed=true  |
| The object that it was deployed from            | name=internal-ca                           | name=internal-ca, changed=false |

## Method delete

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | delete                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Description | Remove a certificate authority that osapi deployed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Detail      | Removes the file of the CA and rebuilds the trust store: with update-ca-certificates --fresh on the Debian family and SUSE, which removes the links of the CA from /etc/ssl/certs, and update-ca-trust on the RHEL family. A CA that osapi did not deploy does not change and reports changed: false: a system CA is not osapi's to remove. macOS reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | DELETE                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/certificate/&#123;name&#125;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Permission  | certificate:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Command     | [osapi client node certificate delete](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/certificate/delete.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Input type  | DeleteInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS               | DESCRIPTION                                     |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| name  | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ | The CA that osapi deployed, such as internal-ca |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The CA                   |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |
